productOnPage.title: Robotronix Pandemonix - It's YOUR Adventure
productOnPage.author: Amber Hatch
productOnPage.description: Can you find the replacement chip to fix your glitch? Or will you crash through the factory on a path of confusion and chaos? Just watch out Mr Gizmo doesn’t send you back to the supplier.This is YOUR adventure. With 20 different pathways through 71 tracks and 4 hours 12 mins of original audio, YOU choose how your robotic journey unfolds.Perfect for listeners who love funny, silly, interactive stories. Tracks included: Intro Welcome to the Robotronix factory Hear the factory rules Warn them of the danger Head to the fire exit Try to work things out by yourself Wait and see what Mr Gizmo has to say Try removing the fly with the mini vacuum Climb off the bench Practice dancing Start spraying foam Return to the supplier Ride in the trolley Choose the blue legs Ready to come out the box Stay clinging on Wait outside Mr Gizmo’s office Look in the metal case Keep quiet Find a hiding place Unlock the door with swipe card Examine the plastic rectangle Load up the Surf Dreams card Go back down the corridor Find out what Sally plans to do Say nothing Hold a team meeting Escape on the scooter Lollop towards the exit Demand Sally fixes you Try the psychoanalysis Re-insert broken chip Discover your new role Climb the stairs to the staff room Use one of the gadgets on your robot hand Untangle the trousers Explain things your own way Insert the skull and crossbones card Leave Mr Gizmo alone and go back to the factory floor Have the new chip Wait for Sally Release your electromagnets Go after Sally See the technicians Activate emergency shut down The end of tea break Choose springs Show Mr Gizmo his swipe card Play soothing nature noises Hide on the shelf See how things work out Process what just happened Be assigned to your new job Really have the new chip It's tea break Insert “Be a winner!” Use the marker pen to write a warning Cut a hole through the back of the locker Switch on your night vision Stop Sally’s screwdriver Use your speaker system Integrate the chip in your system Put on the orange suit Insert the chili pepper card  Run after the humans Stick with the new chip Activity 1 – Draw a scene  Activity 2 – Make a junk-model robot Activity 3 – Continue the story Activity 4 - Make up some sound effects The end of your adventure Outro

yotoCreatorModal.body:
#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
